query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-20T09:59:11Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T09:59:11Z"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.16"
        AND event.outcome == "failure"
        AND NOT (message LIKE "*password*" OR message LIKE "*publickey*")
| STATS events = COUNT(*) BY message
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 3

values.message: pam_unix(sshd:auth): authentication failure; logname= uid=0 euid=0 tty=ssh ruser= rhost=172.18.0.16  user=root
